title: OG Safe Chat for Roblox
features:
❗ SCRIPT MAY HAVE TERRIBLE MOBILE SUPPORT ❗
❗ SCRIPT REQUIRES LEVEL 3+ EXECUTOR IN ORDER TO WORK ❗

hi everyone! i present to you my script, that replicates almost one-to-one old roblox super safe chat feature. it was present from 2007, up to 2014, when it was removed from roblox. you can find out more about it by looking online, or reading this wiki section:
> https://roblox.fandom.com/wiki/In-experience_chat#Filtering

i made the script because i couldn't find any other online, or i didn't look good enough for it.

[CREDITS]
> Super Nostalgia Zone by @Maximum_ADHD [ROBLOX]
- idea, GUI, main script functionality
> Roblox 2007 Client by MirayXS [GITHUB]
- 2007 safechat
> Roblox 2009 Client by Maximum_ADHD [GITHUB]
- 2009 safechat
> Roblox 2016 Client by jxyserr [GITHUB]
- 2016 safechat
script:
--[[
    hi! keep in mind that this script has almost no support for mobile devices.
    the script may also overlap with other gui's (because it was designed to have NO other gui's in its path)
    level 3+ is required (because the script tries to access CoreGui),
    but can be changed in the script (more chance of detection),
    the script is made by mehhovcki. have fun :D
]]

_G.safeChatVersion = "2016" -- 2007/2009/2016
_G.keyToDestroy = Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl -- https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/enums/KeyCode
if _G.safeChatVersion ~= "2007" and _G.safeChatVersion ~= "2009" and _G.safeChatVersion ~= "2016" then
    return print("[!] safeChatVersion isn't 2007, 2009 or 2016. pls fix :c")
end

loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mehh0vcki/scripts/refs/heads/main/safechat.lua"))()
